text.tspan: "Vehicle occupants and road users need the vehicle to warn its driver and to brake when a collision with a vehicle ahead in its lane is imminent, and to do neither when it is not."
"The vehicle drives with the candidate active, and its front camera and speed deliver input while a vehicle target is ahead in its lane or in view outside its path."

"For a vehicle target ahead in the lane, the warning request leads to the collision warning on the display and as a sound, and the driving command brakes the vehicle; where no collision is imminent, neither a warning nor braking is given."
